newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 10.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
* Attorney General Janet Reno is ready to oppose immunity for John Huang, whose political money-raising activities are at the heart of Senate hearings.
* Apple Computer Inc announced the resignation of its charman and chief executive.
* The American labor force is continuing to grow considerably faster than the working age population.
* Mike Tyson received the strictest penalty possible under Nevada rules for biting Evander Holyfield's ears in last month's heavyweight title fight.
* Ruth Messinger kicks off her campaign for mayor of New York City, saying the current mayor Rudolph Giuliani caters to the rich.
* Sheik Hamad bin Khalifa has adopted a course so distinctive it has caused alarm in neighboring Persian Gulf oil monarchies.
